Your new game is a one or a two player model with a color T.V. monitor. The game has five posstble modes of operation: ATTRACT, READY-TO-PLAY, PLAY, HIGH SCORE/INITIAL, and SELF-TEST.
SELF-TEST MODE
The Self-Test mode Is a special mode for checking the game switches and computer functions. It ts the most complete way of checking for proper game operation and Is quite easy to use.

The Self-Test mode may be entered at any time and from any mode of operation. Simply locate the black slide switch tnside the coin box compartment and slide It to the Self-Test position. With this switch in the Self-Test position, activate the siam switch located on the coln door, The game will enter the Self-Test mode Immediately and display the following test menuseess

SELF DIAGNOSTICS: This test Is designed to effectively locate and identify any malfunction of the on-board computer. When selected, the game enters this mode Immediately and begins scanning the memory stored In rom and ram. If a defective component Is found during the*scan, that component and it's location will be displayed on screen. It wil! take about 15 seconds to perform the entire test.

SOUNDS: When selected, this test will display a menu of sounds. The first two selections on the menu are ALL and EXIT. tf you move the cursor to select ALL, the game will automatically perform a test of all the sounds on the menu. If you move the cursor to select EX!T, the game will exit the sound test and return to the main menu page. While In the sound test, any selection on the sound menu may be tested Individually by pos{tioning the cursor next to that sound and pressing the tire button.

PLAYER INPUT: This test is designed to confirm the operation of al! player Inputs and devices in the game. For example, when you wish to test the coin switches on the coin door, you would enter this test and activate te coin switches. if the switches are operating property, the screen will display the words COIN CHITE 1 or COIN CHUTE 2 depending on which coin switch has been activated. All inputs, contro{s, service switches, player selection buttons, etc. may be tested in the same manner, To extt this test, activate the coin door slam switch,

ROOKKEEPING: A very useful tool, this test is designed to assist you In tuning your game for your ltocation, When selected, the screen displays a complete and highly accurate account of al! games played. The {nformation displayed includes high scores, low scores, coins collected, longest and shortest games played. There Ts atso an extensive score report and time report that may be accessed by positioning the cursor next to those selections. To ex{t this test, position cursor next to EXIT and press the fire button.
